description: Defines the absl::CordBuffer class, a move-only data structure for managing memory buffers used in building large Cord objects with custom or default size limits. Includes methods for creating buffers, accessing and modifying data, and internal representation details.

classes.name: CordBuffer
classes.description: A move-only class managing memory buffers for building large Cord objects, supporting custom and default size limits, with methods for data access, size management, and internal representation.

methods.name: CreateWithDefaultLimit
methods.description: Creates a CordBuffer with capacity capped at the default limit.

methods.name: CreateWithCustomLimit
methods.description: Creates a CordBuffer with capacity rounded to a power of two, up to a specified block size.

methods.name: MaximumPayload
methods.description: Returns the maximum payload size for a CordBuffer.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Returns a span of available writable space in the buffer.

methods.name: available_up_to
methods.description: Returns a span of available space limited to a specified size.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer's data for writing.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the current data length in the buffer.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: IncreaseLengthBy
methods.description: Increases the data length by a specified amount after writing data.
